The '''Sanbra sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="air" /> It contained the [[Rugosa system/Legends|Rugosa system]].<ref name="EAOC" />
